system.description: A milky moonstone lens the Moon-Watchers ground from a sliver that fell when the moon began to shrink. Once per day, as ◈, look through it at a creature you can see in light within 60': the Dark Master tells you its strength tier and one of its passives. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈ Look through it one last time at a creature you can see: the Dark Master tells you its HP, every passive and gloom ability, and one thing it fears.
system.drawback: Lun's eye turns from you: Bane on Sanity tests made at night until it is recovered.
